source_clauses.verbatim: I need a clamp that fixes a monitor arm to the edge of my desk.
Desk edges here are between 18 and 40 mm thick.
Once it is tight it must not slip or rotate under the weight of the arm.
I want to be able to take it off and move it to another desk without any tools.

freedoms.decision: The mechanism and materials of the clamp are not specified.
freedoms.why_free: The request does not state how the clamp should achieve fixing, slipping resistance, or tool-free removal.

freedoms.decision: The exact shape and size of the clamp are not specified.
freedoms.why_free: No dimensions or form are given other than the desk edge thickness range.

ambiguities.statement: The weight of the arm is not quantified; it is only referred to as 'the weight of the arm'.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: When the specific monitor arm model and its weight are known.

assumptions.statement: The desk edge thickness range is inclusive.
assumptions.why: The phrase 'between 18 and 40 mm thick' is interpreted as inclusive of both endpoints.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: Explicit statement that the range excludes one or both endpoints.
